propositions: A rejected tickets-branch auto-push succeeds locally and reports success to the caller while the write silently fails to reach the remote, breaking the concurrency contract that every write propagates immediately.

Ticket event payloads (comments, raw environment output) are never scanned for secrets on write, even though the repository runs gitleaks as a code-review gate; credentials can be pasted into comments undetected.

The rejection classifier _NON_FF uses an over-broad substring match on 'rejected' that misroutes policy declines (pre-receive hook declined, push protection) onto the retry path, discarding the git error reason and burning futile fetch+merge cycles instead of reporting the terminal failure.

The divergence signal PUSH_PENDING is computed only from an explicit fsck pull, never from a write path, so a rejected auto-push's growing backlog is never re-announced and remains invisible for hours.

A real local bare origin with a pre-receive hook declining with GH013-shaped stderr must be driven to test the rejection surfacing, not mocked; the warning must name the git rejection reason and include the unpushed commit count.
